command:
set -euo pipefail
LA="$HOME/local-agent"
WT="/private/tmp/local-agent-chat-bridge-wake-only-v45"
BR="chat-bridge-wake-only-v45"
BASE="334a6c373b179061dd8cb544743b26fae34c4e50"
test -d "$WT/.git" || test -f "$WT/.git"
test "$(git -C "$WT" branch --show-current)" = "$BR"
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE"
test -n "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
cd "$WT"
if grep -R -n -E 'repositoryId|repository id|routing hint' chat_bridge --include='*.js' --exclude='*.test.js'; then echo 'Unexpected repository routing residue in runtime code' >&2; exit 1; fi
node --check chat_bridge/control_protocol.js
node --check chat_bridge/bridge_state.js
node --check chat_bridge/control_protocol.test.js
node --check chat_bridge/bridge_state.test.js
node --check chat_bridge/service_worker.js
node --check chat_bridge/service_worker.test.js
node --check chat_bridge/content.js
node --check chat_bridge/popup.js
node chat_bridge/control_protocol.test.js
node chat_bridge/bridge_state.test.js
node chat_bridge/service_worker.test.js
python3 -m json.tool chat_bridge/manifest.json >/dev/null
python3 -m json.tool chat_bridge/runtime.example.json >/dev/null
git diff --check
git add chat_bridge
git commit -m 'Simplify Chat Bridge to wake-only transport' >/dev/null
CANDIDATE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
git push --quiet -u origin "$BR"
echo "CANDIDATE_SHA=$CANDIDATE"
echo "WAKE_ONLY_BRIDGE_TESTS=PASS"
